description: Three equal upright square outlines form a triangular arrangement, with one centred above two separated lower squares. Each square has an empty interior and remains detached from its neighbours.
The digits 403 sit in one horizontal row. An angular open four precedes a tall oval zero and a three with two rounded lobes facing right.
The digits 911 stand side by side on a common baseline. The nine has a round upper bowl and curved descending tail, followed by two tall ones with angled tops.
A circular inner bowl joins a returning curve on the right, surrounded by a broad outer loop. The outer loop remains open near the lower-right edge.
A rounded central bowl connects to a smaller return on its right within a sweeping outer loop. The outer stroke curls around the bowl and ends below it.
An uppercase A and the digit 4 stand side by side. The A has a softly rounded apex and horizontal crossbar; the four has a diagonal arm crossing a vertical stem.
An uppercase A precedes a digit 5 on a common baseline. The A has a rounded apex and crossbar, while the five has a flat top and rounded lower bowl.
An uppercase B and the digit 4 form a horizontal pair. The B has two rounded bowls, and the four has an open triangular top and a projecting crossbar.
An uppercase R stands beside a lowercase h. The R has a rounded upper bowl and diagonal leg; the h has a tall ascender and one rounded shoulder.
A long horizontal line crosses a matching upright line at their centres. Four straight, evenly balanced arms extend from the junction, with no surrounding enclosure or added marks.
The uppercase letters API appear in a single horizontal row. A has a crossbar, P has a rounded upper bowl, and I has short horizontal bars at its top and bottom.
The text 2M appears above a horizontal double-headed arrow. The numeral has a curved top and diagonal lower stroke; the capital M has two tall peaks.
A large 2M label sits above a long horizontal arrow with heads at both ends. The two has a rounded top, and the M uses tall sloping strokes.
The text 2m stands above a horizontal double-headed arrow. A rounded numeral two sits beside a lowercase m with two rounded shoulders, aligned across the same baseline.
A straight downward arrow meets the centre of a short horizontal bar. Its long upright shaft ends in two diagonal arms forming a broad symmetrical arrowhead.
A horizontal arrow points right toward a separate small circular outline. The circle sits directly ahead of the open arrowhead, with a visible gap between them.
An arrow rises vertically from the lower left, turns through a rounded corner, and continues horizontally right. Its tip ends in an open, symmetrical right-facing arrowhead.
A tall straight arrow points upward to the centre of a horizontal bar. Two diagonal arms descend from its tip, forming a broad arrowhead beneath the bar.
A long diagonal shaft rises from lower left to upper right. A horizontal top arm and a vertical right arm meet at its endpoint to form the arrowhead.
Two broad curved arrows follow opposite halves of a circular path. Their open arrowheads sit at upper right and lower left, with gaps separating the two arcs.
A wide battery body forms a rounded rectangular outline with an empty interior. A smaller rounded terminal projects from the middle of its right edge and joins the body.
A bed appears from the side as a long rectangular mattress between two upright posts. The left post rises well above the mattress, while both posts extend below it.
Two upright bombs sit diagonally apart, the left one higher than the right. Each has a rounded oblong body and an angular tail fin with a central V-shaped notch.
Two rounded oblong bombs hang beneath angular tail fins, with one positioned above and left of the other. Each fin has a V-shaped notch across its upper edge.
An open book shows two broad blank pages joined by a central vertical spine. Their upper and lower edges bow gently, meeting in central notches above and below.
A bottle tilts from upper right toward lower left, its open neck facing a detached teardrop below. A broad curved interior line separates the liquid area inside the bottle.
A diagonal bottle pours toward the lower left, with a single pointed drop beneath its mouth. Its rounded body contains a sweeping curved boundary marking the liquid within.
A large circular bubble touches a smaller circle at its upper-right edge. Both interiors are empty, and the two rounded outlines meet without a separate action or status mark.
A large uppercase C is followed by two plus signs aligned across its middle. The C is rounded and open to the right, while both plus signs have equal crossing arms.
A circular outline contains a straight diagonal slash running from lower left to upper right. The slash joins the outer ring at both ends and divides its empty interior.
A rounded square chip has two short pins projecting from each of its four sides. The central body remains empty, and the evenly spaced pins form a balanced outline.
A circular hinge sits above two widely spread compass legs. A diagonal adjustment bar crosses between the legs, ending in a short transverse cap, and a small stem rises above the hinge.
Two long spread legs meet a circular upper hinge, with a short stem extending beyond it. A slanted adjustment bar links the legs and ends in a small crosswise cap.
A round face contains two short vertical eyes above a broad upward-curving smile. The features are centred within the circular head and form a balanced, open expression.
Two concentric circular outlines share one centre, with a broad empty band between them. The smaller ring encloses an empty centre, and no crosshairs or arrows are visible.
A long curved arrow follows most of a clockwise circle and ends at the upper right. Its head has horizontal and vertical arms, and a gap separates the tip from the tail.
Three heart-shaped leaves meet at a shared central junction, pointing upward, left, and right. A narrow curved stem descends from the junction beneath the spreading leaves.
A wide upright rectangle is divided by two full-height vertical lines into three equal columns. All three interiors remain blank, with no visibly selected or shaded column.
Two evenly spaced vertical dividers split a rectangular outline into three matching blank panels. The top and bottom edges run continuously across the full width of the table.
Two upright parallel lines cross two horizontal parallel lines to form an open grid. The strokes extend beyond their four intersections; no letters or outer rectangular border are visible.
An isometric cube shows its top and two side faces above an L-shaped measurement arrow. The arrow runs along the bottom and right, pointing left and upward at its two ends.
A broad outlined pointer faces horizontally left. Its long sloping sides meet at a sharp tip, while the right edge bends inward to form a shallow concave notch.
A wide outlined cursor points right, with two long sloping sides meeting at its tip. The rear edge has a shallow inward notch centred between its upper and lower corners.
A long diagonal arrow descends from upper left to lower right. Its open head has horizontal and vertical arms meeting at the endpoint, with rounded ends on the broad strokes.
A large S-shaped curve is crossed by one continuous vertical line extending beyond its top and bottom. The upper and lower bowls turn in opposite directions around the stem.
A horizontal shaft ends in a right-pointing open arrowhead, followed by a second detached right chevron. The two heads are aligned across the same horizontal centre.
Two empty rounded rectangular speech bubbles overlap diagonally, the larger front bubble above and right. Each has a pointed lower-right tail, while part of the rear bubble is hidden.
A broad downward arrow has a tall rectangular shaft and a wide triangular head. The outline encloses an empty interior, with matching horizontal shoulders on both sides.
Two nested curved arcs spread above a tiny central dot. The upper arc is wider than the lower one, and all three elements share the same vertical axis.
A tall rectangular building stands beside a lower right-hand annex with a sloping roof. Two short horizontal window marks sit on the tower, and both sections share a baseline.
A large C-shaped currency curve is crossed by a single horizontal bar extending left of its stem. The curve remains open on the right, with rounded upper and lower ends.
Two broad curved eyelids meet at pointed left and right corners to form a horizontal almond outline. A tiny central dot appears inside, without a visible iris ring.
A circular face has sharply inward-slanting eyebrows above tiny eyes and a small downturned mouth. The brows form the strongest interior marks, giving the balanced face a stern expression.
A tall uppercase F has a long top bar and a shorter middle bar. A tiny detached degree mark appears above and to its left in the reference.
A closed flower-shaped outline has six broad rounded lobes arranged around an empty centre. Its upper and lower lobes sit on the vertical axis, with paired lobes spreading left and right.
A separate rounded head sits above a short-sleeved torso with curved shoulders. Two nearly vertical sides descend from the sleeve notches, leaving the lower body open in the reference.
A low, wide rectangular block has gently rounded corners and a blank front. It appears alone as a shallow horizontal slab, without a gavel or other surrounding object.
A hand enters diagonally from the upper right and points toward the lower left. A projecting thumb separates from the long rounded finger mass, and the wrist remains open.
Two open hands face inward as a balanced pair, with upright outer fingers and curved palms. Their thumbs angle toward the central gap, and short wrists extend downward.
An upward-pointing index finger sits below the left side of an isometric cube. The cube shows its top and right faces, with a gap in the lower-left outline above the hand.
An Om glyph combines a large double-curved left body with a sweeping right-hand loop. A smaller upper curve and a detached dot sit above the right side.
A large circular key bow sits at the upper right of a diagonal shaft extending down-left. Two short teeth project from one side near the shaft's lower end.
A broad leaf lies horizontally with a rounded left base and pointed right tip. A curved central vein enters from the lower left and stops inside the blade.
A broad leaf points upper-left, with a bowed right edge and a rounded lower base. Its curved vein extends through the base into a stem descending lower-right.
An upright heart has two rounded lobes, a deep central notch, and a pointed bottom. Two horizontal dividers cross the interior, forming three broad stacked bands.
A tall outlined lightning bolt follows a sharp zigzag between an upper-right tip and lower-left tip. Two inward notches create the offset middle section, leaving the interior open.
The uppercase word LIVE runs across one horizontal line in narrow open lettering. The I has short top and bottom serifs, while the V has a softly rounded bottom.
A map pin has a rounded upper body tapering evenly into a sharp downward point. A small circular opening sits inside the upper half, centred beneath the crown.
An upright suitcase has a broad body with rounded corners, a short rectangular handle above, and two short supports below. Its front remains completely blank.
Three long horizontal strokes are stacked with equal spacing and aligned ends. Each stroke remains separate, creating an open three-line menu glyph without an enclosing shape.
Five separate vertical bars form an uneven audio waveform around a common horizontal centre. The middle bar is tallest, with shorter bars on both sides and a very short far-right bar.
A long horizontal bar has broad rounded corners and an empty interior. Its squat proportions form a single outlined minus without surrounding marks or an enclosing badge.
A tall hexagonal body has gently rounded corners and a round central opening. Two curved claw-like appendages extend from the lower sides and bend outward before turning inward at their tips.
Two long pins have large circular heads and thin straight shafts. The upper pin points diagonally down-left; the lower pin lies horizontally with its head at the right.
A bell has a rounded crown with a small top knob, widening sides, and a flared straight lower rim. A tiny detached horizontal clapper appears beneath the centre.
A wide trapezoidal panel is divided into four sections by a horizontal crossbar and central vertical line. The vertical line continues downward as a single supporting post.
Three detached circular toe pads surround the upper half of an upright triangular main pad. The top circle is centred, with lower circles placed evenly to the left and right.
A front-facing person with a round head and plain short-sleeved torso stands beside a tall ruler. Three short measuring ticks project inward from the ruler's right edge.
A round head floats above a reclining body suggested by a bent arm and sloping leg. A broad curved seat supports the figure, with a tall left back and rounded front.
A detached round head sits above broad curved shoulders enclosed by short upright sides and a straight lower edge. The head and torso have no internal details.
A curved handset runs from upper left to lower right, joining two widened earpieces. Rounded corners soften the ends and the deep inner bend of its connecting grip.
A round pig face has two outward-pointing ears attached at its upper sides. Two short upright eyes sit above a large rounded snout with a blank interior.
A long straight upright pin supports a large circular head at its upper end. The thin shaft attaches at the head's bottom centre and extends far downward.
A rounded map pin tapers into a pointed lower tip. A circular opening is centred within its broad upper portion, following the same upright alignment as the outer shape.
A large outlined triangle points right with three sharp corners and an empty interior. Its left edge is vertical, with matching slopes meeting at the rightmost tip.
A plus sign stands above a separate horizontal minus stroke. The plus has equal crossing arms, and the lower line is centred beneath it with a broad vertical gap.
A stacked mound has a broad flat-bottomed base, bulging curved tiers, and an asymmetric pointed peak leaning right. The continuous outline contains no face or interior divisions.
An almost complete circular arc opens at the top around a detached upright stroke. The central stroke descends from above the arc into its upper interior.
A broad circular arc has a clear opening at the top and a separate vertical stroke centred in that opening. The stroke extends down toward the circle's centre.
A curved arrow rises around a broad right-hand bend and ends in a horizontal left-pointing head. Its lower tail starts near the bottom centre and remains open.
A square jigsaw piece has a round tab rising from its top and round sockets opening into its left and bottom edges. The right edge stays straight and its outer corners are rounded.
Three outlined drops form a triangular group, with one centred above two evenly spaced lower drops. Each has a pointed top, curved sides, and a rounded lower bowl.
Two broad curved arrows trace opposite halves of a circle with gaps between their ends. The upper arc points down-right and the lower arc points up-left, forming a clockwise cycle.
A small upright phone overlaps a larger device behind it at the upper right. Both have rounded corners and a horizontal lower-screen divider, with the rear outline interrupted by the front device.
A broad bell has a smoothly domed top, nearly upright sides, and a flared flat rim. A detached horizontal clapper sits below the centre of the rim.
A large circular ring band supports a polygonal gemstone above it. The gem has a flat top, angled upper corners, and sloping lower sides partly hidden by the band.
Two long diagonal strokes meet at a shallow central peak, creating an open gabled roof. The matching slopes descend toward widely separated left and right ends without walls underneath.
Two sloping sides meet at a softly rounded peak to form an open triangular mound. Three tiny grain marks appear inside, with one above two lower marks.
A pointed shield with a peaked upper centre contains a smaller matching shield. Both have bowed shoulders, upright upper sides, and curved lower sides meeting at a bottom point.
An upright rounded square is divided by two horizontal lines into three bands. A short central vertical divider splits only the middle band, creating four empty compartments.
Three separate curved strokes nest above one another, growing wider toward the top. Each bows upward around the same centre, without a dot or any enclosing shape.
An open lightning zigzag stands between scattered short upright snow marks. The bolt descends diagonally through the centre, while the small marks form loose columns on either side.
A vertical and horizontal axis cross at the centre, each carrying two short angled branches near its outer ends. The resulting snowflake has four evenly distributed branching arms.
An upright spoon with a broad round bowl stands beside a knife. The knife has a straight left edge, a curved pointed blade, and a long narrow handle below.
A large uppercase sigma has long horizontal top and bottom bars joined by two inward-sloping diagonals. The diagonals meet at a central right-facing point, leaving the right side open.
A front-facing swimmer has a round head crossed by a horizontal cap edge and a broad shoulder arc below. A separate wavy water line runs beneath the shoulders.
A blank diagonal tag has rounded outer corners and a sloping pointed right end. A tiny attachment hole sits near the broad upper-left corner, inside the otherwise empty outline.
A circle is crossed centrally by long horizontal and vertical lines. Both lines extend beyond the circumference on opposite sides, creating four evenly spaced outward arms.
A circular outline has short crosshair ticks at its top, bottom, left, and right. A tiny central dot sits between the four inward-facing tick ends.
Three straight arrows point downward, with the central arrow positioned lower than the two outer arrows. Each has a long upright shaft and an open V-shaped head.
A closed hand raises one curved thumb upward while the curled fingers form a broad right edge. The wrist begins at the lower left and the palm rounds into a flat lower contour.
Three matching open lightning zigzags stand side by side. Each has two long sloping segments joined by a short horizontal middle stroke, with clear gaps between the bolts.
A slightly tapered bin has rounded lower corners and a wide flat lid topped by an arched handle. One short vertical groove appears in the centre of the body.
An upright open-bodied bin has straight sides, rounded bottom corners, and a flat lid projecting beyond both sides. A short vertical handle rises from the lid's centre.
A tapered bin with rounded bottom corners sits beneath a wide projecting lid. A rounded rectangular handle rises centrally above the lid, and the body remains blank.
A rounded rectangular lock body supports an arched shackle attached on the left. The shackle curves over the body and ends freely above its upper-right edge.
A narrow rectangular metal connector projects above a wider rounded housing. The housing has short upright sides and a broad curved lower end, with no interior markings.
A wide rounded rectangular camera body has a trapezoidal lens hood attached to its right side. The hood widens toward its upright outer edge, and the body stays blank.
A rectangular camera body joins a flared right-facing lens hood in one angular outline. A deep notch separates the top of the body from the hood's upper slope.
A rounded rectangular camera body supports two circular film reels of unequal size above it. A short trapezoidal lens hood projects from the body's right side and widens outward.
A rounded rectangular wallet has a short fastening tab projecting from its right side with a tiny central stud. A slanted card peeks above the wallet's top edge.
Two curved arrows form an open circular clock surround, with heads at the left and right. Inside, joined clock hands point upward and right from a shared corner.
Two horizontal wind strokes extend from the left and curl into rounded hooks at the right. The upper hook turns upward and the shorter lower hook turns downward.
Three separate horizontal curves form gently undulating wind lines stacked with even spacing. Each rises on the left, dips through the right half, and curls slightly upward at its ending.
